@graph.name: CM4AI U2OS Release: IF Image Downloader
@graph.description: Immunofluorescence (IF) images downloaded from the Human Protein Atlas (HPA) version 23 for U2OS cell lines. Images were obtained using the cellmaps_imagedownloader tool, which retrieves IF microscopy images for genes of interest. Each image captures protein localization patterns via antibody staining with blue (nucleus/DAPI), red (microtubules), and green (target protein) channels. This dataset covers approximately 10,825 unique gene targets.

@graph.conditionsOfAccess: Attribution is required to the copyright holders and the authors. Any publications referencing this data or derived products should cite the related article as well as directly citing this data collection.

@graph.rai:dataLimitations: This is an interim release. Images are sourced from the Human Protein Atlas and represent antibody-based protein localization in U2OS cells only. Results may not generalize to other cell types or staining conditions. Requires domain expertise for meaningful analysis.
@graph.rai:dataBiases: Data in this release was derived from a single cell line (U2OS) and does not represent all biological variants which may be seen in the population at large. Antibody specificity and staining quality vary across targets.
@graph.rai:dataUseCases: AI-ready datasets to support research in functional genomics, AI/machine learning model training, protein localization prediction, cellular process analysis, and image embedding generation for the Cell Maps pipeline.
@graph.rai:dataCollection: Images were downloaded from the Human Protein Atlas (https://www.proteinatlas.org/) version 23 using the cellmaps_imagedownloader tool.
@graph.usageInfo: These laboratory data are not to be used in clinical decision-making or in any context involving patient care without appropriate regulatory oversight and approval.
@graph.humanSubjectResearch: None - data collected from commercially available cell lines
@graph.completeness: Protein-protein interaction (BioPlex AP-MS) and protein localization (HPA IF imaging) data interrogate sets of proteins which incompletely overlap. Release covers U2OS only.
@graph.prohibitedUses: These laboratory data are not to be used in clinical decision-making or in any context involving patient care without appropriate regulatory oversight and approval.
@graph.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Release-level RO-Crate is versioned and updated alongside the CM4AI pipeline sub-crates through the end of the project (November 2026). Long-term preservation in https://dataverse.lib.virginia.edu/, supported by committed institutional funds.
@graph.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Protein-protein interaction (BioPlex AP-MS) and protein localization (HPA IF imaging) interrogate protein sets that only partially overlap; ~5,147 of the proteins detectable in U2OS are represented in both modalities, and the remainder appear in only one of the two input sources.

@graph.description: cellmaps_imagedownloader is a Python tool that downloads immunofluorescence microscopy images from the Human Protein Atlas (HPA). It retrieves IF images for specified genes and antibodies, organizing them by color channel (blue, red, green, yellow) and generating gene node attribute files for downstream analysis in the Cell Maps pipeline.
